name: pdf_located_annotation
description: Comments on one PDF page, each tied to text or a figure on that page so it can be placed as a MarkUs PDF annotation.

content.description: The comment shown to the student.

quote.description: 2 to 8 words copied exactly from this page that the comment is about, e.g. a sentence fragment, code, or an axis label. Empty string if the comment is about a plot as a whole.

figure.description: If the comment is about a plot or picture, its number on this page counting from the top; 0 if it is not about a plot.

figure_part.description: Which part of the plot the comment is about ('panel' is the plotting area); 'none' if it is not about a plot.

bar.description: When figure_part is 'bar', the bar's number counting from the left.

x1.description: Left edge of the commented area, in pixels of the page image.

y1.description: Top edge of the commented area, in pixels of the page image.

x2.description: Right edge of the commented area, in pixels of the page image.

y2.description: Bottom edge of the commented area, in pixels of the page image.
